parameters.name: ActionConfig
parameters.description: The configuration of the action that is specified in the automated response rule. The value is a JSON array.

parameters.name: ActionType
parameters.description:
The type of the action. Separate multiple values with commas. Valid values:

- **doPlaybook**: runs a playbook

- **changeEventStatus**: changes the status of the event

- **changeThreatLevel**: changes the threat level of the event

parameters.name: AutoResponseType
parameters.description:
The type of the automated response. Valid values:

- **event**: event

- **alert**: alert

parameters.name: ExecutionCondition
parameters.description: The trigger condition of the automated response rule. The value is in the JSON format.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The ID of the automated response rule.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- **ap-southeast-1**: your assets are outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the user that the administrator uses to switch the view. This parameter is used when an administrator switches to the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that are managed by the administrator.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the automated response rule.

parameters.name: SubUserId
parameters.description: The ID of the user who created the rule.
